bio: Macdonald Manchester Hotel, is located in the heart of Manchester, just a short walk from Piccadilly Station.  Afternoon Tea is served in the relaxed and comfortable Lounge Bar or Restaurant. Enjoy a freshly prepared selection of delicious finger sandwiches, including Ham and Piccalilli, Cheddar with plum chutney and Coronation chicken. F luffy scones are served with jam and clotted cream, along with a selection of cakes, including Chocolate croustillant, Raspberry eclair and Pistachio and chocolate financier.  Afternoon Tea is served with your choice of tea or coffee and can be made gluten free, dairy free, vegetarian and vegan.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 12pm to 3pm and costs £25 per person, or £29 with a glass of Prosecco.
